newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-ALBANIAN LEAGUE STILL ON HOLD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBANIAN LEAGUE STILL ON HOLD.

text.p: Albanian soccer officials said on Wednesday they would wait for guarantees on security from the Interior Ministry before re-starting the national league championship.
The matches have been called off for the past month because of widespread protests and unrest after several popular pyramid investment schemes collapsed.

Eduard Dervishi, the secretary general of the Albanian football association told a news conference he was awaiting a response from police despite receiving a go-ahead to re-start matches from the state's sports secretary Marjeta Zace.

"Police forces should take the responsibility for holding of the soccer matches, for the free movement of teams around the country and for the security of our officials during matches," Dervishi said.
Officials have been concerned that the large gatherings of spectators could spark anti-government demonstrations.

Albania's government cancelled all sports events last month when demonstrators started mass protests around the country but last Monday Zace told the soccer federation to re-start the national championships.
